title: NH-48 Road Safety Improvements – Design of Multiple LVUPs
description: Detailed engineering design and preparation of Good for Construction (GFC) drawings for multiple Light Vehicular Underpasses (LVUPs) at grade junctions identified as road safety black spots along the Tumakuru–Chitradurga section of NH-48 (Old NH-4), from Km 75+000 to Km 189+000. The project includes underpass locations at Nelahalu, Ajjagondanahalli Circle Dhaba, Javagondanahalli, Gorladaku, Kasturi Rangappahalli and Giddobanahalli, under EPC mode for black spot rectification.
